examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: Use cut/cycle properties, carefully handling equal weights. An edge can belong to some MSTs without belonging to all. Count Kruskal alternatives after contracting lighter-edge components. An MST minimizes total tree weight, not every pairwise path distance.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
A triangle has edge weights 1,2,2. How many minimum spanning trees exist?

**Answer: 2.** A tree uses two edges. Pairing weight 1 with either weight 2 gives total 3. Using both weight-2 edges gives 4. Exactly two distinct edge sets are minimum.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
Adding the same constant to every edge preserves MST ordering since all spanning trees have |V|−1 edges. It can change shortest paths.

Negative edge weights are allowed in MST problems.
